pages.text: SYN Business Review analyst note on Kito Agri (SYN). The analyst set a twelve-month target price of SYN Sh 193.20 for KIT0. The note cites steady demand in the agri sector and cost control at Kito Agri (SYN). Trading volumes were broadly in line with the previous month, according to exchange data. Industry groups welcomed the clarity but asked for more investor education. Analysts at several brokerages said they expected conditions to stay stable through the quarter.
